subject.title: [Security] Improper redaction of Authorization headers in Crabbox diagnostic exports

question: Can the claimed nested Authorization payload be reproduced against current main through the actual diagnostics export, and should this public report be transferred to private advisory handling?
rationale: The issue alleges reusable credential disclosure but supplies no artifact or exact payload, while current source already has a dedicated safety boundary and direct Bearer-token coverage; maintainers must validate impact without soliciting sensitive evidence publicly.

options.title: Reproduce Privately
options.body: Move the investigation to a private advisory, request a synthetic payload and affected ZIP entry, and patch the actual sanitizer only if current main leaks it.

options.title: Request Safe Public Detail
options.body: Keep the issue public but request only synthetic reproduction steps, version information, and token-free ZIP entry names before changing code.

options.title: Close After Negative Proof
options.body: Close only after a bounded current-main reproduction covers the claimed nested serialization shape and confirms every exported entry remains redacted.

recommendation.title: Reproduce Privately
recommendation.body: Move the investigation to a private advisory, request a synthetic payload and affected ZIP entry, and patch the actual sanitizer only if current main leaks it.

likelyOwner.reason: This cross-cutting core security and disclosure-routing choice needs an experienced core integrator rather than an automated repair lane.
